title: Starlight
summary: STARLIGHT, noun [star and light.] The light proceeding from the stars. Nor walk by moon or glittering starlight without thee is sweet. STARLIGHT, adjective Lighted by the stars, or by the stars only;

inlines.v: STARLIGHT, noun [star and light.] The light proceeding from the stars. Nor walk by moon or glittering starlight without thee is sweet. STARLIGHT, adjective Lighted by the stars, or by the stars only; as a starlight evening.
